description: Nature of a single TextDiffHunk. It drives both the rendering (inserted text, removed text) and the decision a consumer offers: a Replace hunk is one decision even though it covers both sides.

members.name: Equal
members.description: The text is present in both inputs; there is nothing to decide.

members.name: Insert
members.description: Text exists only in the new input, so OldText is empty.

members.name: Delete
members.description: Text exists only in the old input, so NewText is empty.

members.name: Replace
members.description: Old text was replaced by new text; both sides are accepted or rejected together.
